title: Untoward
summary: UNTO'WARD, adjective 1. Froward; perverse; refractory; not easily guided or taught. Acts 2:40. 2. Awkward; ungraceful; as untoward words. 3. Inconvenient; troublesome; unmanageable; as an untoward vow
